----Respondents
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Laxman Bishnoi.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Rajpurohit, P.P.
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Monga
Order 09/10/2024
1.

Petitioner is before this Court seeking quashing of an Fir No.42/2023 dated 27.02.2023,
registered at Police Station Hathipal, District Udaipur, for the alleged offences under Sections 420,
467, 468 and 471 of Ipc.
2.

Heard.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner argues that the allegation of issuance of bogus mark-sheet as alleged in the FIR, is leveled against as many as 20 persons, and the petitioner is neither named in the FIR nor has any role been attributed to him.
However, the police officials are unnecessarily harassing him.
Petitioner asserts that FIR has been registered on the basis of false allegations levelled against him.
The same thus deserves to be quashed, qua the petitioner.

[2024:RJ-JD:41536] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6877/2024]
4. Having heard the contentions and upon perusal of case file and the FIR, I am of the view that it would not be appropriate to invoke the discretionary jurisdiction vested under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. (Now Section 528 of BNSS) and quash the FIR summarily on the basis of self serving affidavit of petitioners/accused.

sentences.text: Whether or not the allegations are false is a matter of investigation, and it is not for this Court at this preliminary stage to adjudicate on the same.

6. However, it is expected of the Investigating Officer to strictly follow the guidelines rendered by Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Anr 1 and proceed further in accordance with the law.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar and Anr 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Meanwhile, petitioner is directed to join the investigation.

If during the investigation, in case any incriminating material of such nature is found against the petitioner, which prima facie is suggestive of any cognizable offence committed by him, warranting his arrest, then a fresh notice under Section 35 of BNSS shall be given to him so as to enable him to seek legal remedy in accordance with the law.
8.
Conversely, it is made clear that in case there is no incriminating material found against the petitioner, appropriate report be filed before the competent court expeditiously.
9. The instant petition is accordingly disposed of.
10. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.

(ARUN MONGA),J 44-Rmathur/-
